content.text: {"core": "Wisdom sits with what is not yet understood, waiting for the shape beneath things to surface. In Abstraction, it works on thinking that has already left the ground. Overdone, the waiting feeds the untethering: Wisdom holds still inside a structure with no floor, and the knowing never lands. Patterns accumulate; nothing closes.", "sheetLine": "The depth kept deepening until there was nowhere left to stand."}
